[[File:Mediglobepic.jpg|thumb]]
'''Mediglobes''' were [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] bubble buildings that treated sick or diseased Gungan patients. [[Portillo]] was a known [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] at a mediglobe of [[New Otoh Gunga]]. The facility used many different remedies and medicines such as [[Peko-peko/Legends|Peko-peko]] blood, [[Ikopi/Legends|ground ikopi antlers]], roots of [[Cambylictus tree/Legends|Cambylictus trees]], the white core of [[t'iil]] roots, [[treeman's herb]] leaves, and the [[woosha plant]].
